# Velstrian

> Velstrian helps UK suppliers find the work, draft answers grounded in their own past bids, and evidence delivery after award. Velstrian serves both sides of a procurement, the supplier responding and the buyer reading responses, in the public and private sector. The pages below are plain explainers and free tools, cited to the underlying legislation and procurement policy notes.

## Products

- [Velstrian Bid](https://velstrian.com/bid/): Respond to tenders, RFPs, RFIs, PQQs and SQs in the public and private sector. Daily tender discovery from Find a Tender, Contracts Finder, Public Contracts Scotland and EU TED (Canada, US federal and World Bank notices available per organisation on request), answers drafted from the supplier's own submitted bids, figures checked in code rather than generated, PPN 026 social value at the 10% minimum weighting, PPN 017 AI disclosure, and commitments tracked against delivery under Procurement Act 2023 s.52. From £49/month.
- [Velstrian Buy](https://velstrian.com/buy/): Build and publish requirements with a deterministic social value rubric, then locate the evidence for each requirement across every response received. Every quote is grounded verbatim in the supplier's own text and dropped if it cannot be located, so nothing is invented. It locates and organises and NEVER scores: the evaluation panel scores, which is what Procurement Act 2023 equal treatment requires. After award, delivery is tracked against what was promised. Buyer Pro is £299/month and Buyer Portfolio £699/month.

## Free tools

- [Tools hub](https://velstrian.com/tools/): Free procurement checks for UK bid teams, cited to the underlying policy. No account required.
- [Tender compliance matrix](https://velstrian.com/tools/tender-compliance-matrix/): Paste the text of a UK tender and read back the requirements its wording states, each one shown with the line it was read from. Rule based, no upload, no account. The social value calculator that used to sit here was withdrawn on 4 August 2026, and both of its URLs now redirect to the PPN 026 glossary entry below.
- [Tender finder](https://velstrian.com/tools/tender-finder/): Search open UK and EU public sector tenders from Find a Tender, Contracts Finder, Public Contracts Scotland and EU TED, published in the last 30 days. Filter by keyword, region, country, value band, closing date and source, 20 results a page. Free, no account, no AI. UK notices are shown under the Open Government Licence v3.0 and TED notices under Commission Decision 2011/833/EU.

## Procurement guides

- [PPN 026 social value: complete guide](https://velstrian.com/blog/ppn-026-social-value-guide/): Which edition applies to a bid, the 10% and 20% minimum weightings, what the evidence has to look like, and the National TOMs framework many buyers use instead.
- [The Procurement Act 2023 for SME bidders](https://velstrian.com/blog/procurement-act-2023-sme-guide/): What changed from 24 Feb 2025: MAT replaces MEAT, the Central Digital Platform and Find a Tender, s.52 KPIs on contracts over £5m, and what it means day-to-day for SMEs.
- [How to find and win your first UK public sector contract](https://velstrian.com/blog/find-first-public-sector-contract/): Where to look (Find a Tender vs Contracts Finder), how to read a tender, SQ vs ITT, the bid/no-bid decision, and PPN 026 social value.
- [How to write a method statement that actually scores](https://velstrian.com/blog/method-statement-that-scores/): Structure, evidence and risk content that earns marks in a UK tender quality response, and the common mistakes that cost them.
- [Frameworks and DPS explained](https://velstrian.com/blog/frameworks-and-dps-explained/): What a framework agreement and a Dynamic Purchasing System are, how Crown Commercial Service and G-Cloud work, and how call-off competitions are run.
- [Responding to corporate RFPs and PQQs in the private sector](https://velstrian.com/blog/private-sector-rfp-pqq-guide/): How private sector procurement differs from public tenders, what a PQQ checks outside government, and what corporate buyers actually score.
- [Blog index](https://velstrian.com/blog/): All Velstrian procurement guides and updates.

## Comparisons

- [Compare Velstrian Bid](https://velstrian.com/compare/): Honest, sourced head-to-heads of Velstrian Bid against the UK bid tools suppliers shortlist, with published pricing and a dated source for every competitor figure.
- [Velstrian Bid vs AutogenAI](https://velstrian.com/compare/bid-vs-autogenai/): SME bid suite with published pricing from £49/month against an enterprise engine that quotes on request.
- [Velstrian Bid vs mytender.io](https://velstrian.com/compare/bid-vs-mytender-io/): Figure-grounding and published pricing against a UK private-cloud drafting platform.
- [Velstrian Bid vs CleanTender](https://velstrian.com/compare/bid-vs-cleantender/): Sector-agnostic bid suite against a soft facilities-management specialist; both publish pricing.
- [Velstrian Bid vs SwiftBid](https://velstrian.com/compare/bid-vs-swiftbid/): Subscription suite from £49/month against a per-bid AI writing service, with the break-even worked through.
- [Social Value Portal vs Velstrian Bid](https://velstrian.com/blog/social-value-portal-vs-bid/): How Velstrian Bid compares to the Social Value Portal for UK suppliers.
